In frames5 and6 (bottom left and second), shorten the split stance substantially: far boot in front almost directly beneath the face, near boot behind almost beneath the cape attachment, no lunging. Far arm swings opposite: forward in frames1/2/8, hidden behind torso in4/5/6, down in3/7. No hand stays extended at the belly. Don't enlarge limbs or simplify costume. Preserve all8 full-body cells, generous transparent gutters. Small relaxed gait, no high knees or running. Exact same canvas layout. No background, floor, shadow, text, grid or guide lines. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND.
